boundary: binary input events through exact counting, integer scale restore and local signed64 partial sum; no PRNG/comparator/SRAM/nonlinearity/BF16
reset: synchronous active-low; no timing false path

counter.operation: C[m,b] = sum_t sum_i (sample[t,i] * w_mag7[m,i] * (-1)^(w_sign[m,i] XOR x_sign[i]) * (bin_id[i]==b))

restore.coeff_compiler: not supplied: calibration/quantization scales and 1/T must be mapped to coeff/rshift and quality-verified separately

accumulator.overflow: saturate plus per-result and sticky flags

technology_status: Functional only until user DC/STA results received; all stated II/latencies are register/handshake counts, not proof of 100MHz
